summary: A designer's portfolio page for Jabin, a free two-axis variable blackletter: a near-black oxblood page where everything is an animated GIF of the font on pink, teal or black. It shows axis values as Glyphs-like metric readouts and ends with three licence cards.

instances.look: Fixed transparent top bar over everything: 'Frida Medrano' left, Work, About, Mail right, underlined; a logotype 'Jabin Typeface' sits centred in the static header. The bar is stitched repeatedly into crops 01-08
Fixed black bar centred at the bottom edge with Instagram → and LinkedIn → links, stitched over crops as well
Four centred lines of thin blackletter on oxblood black, ornate initials swashing out: 'Jabin was developed as a personal exploration of the new Variable font format…'
instances.ux: Static; the only text in the first screen; nothing tells you to scroll
instances.learn: Blackletter at thin weight is legible as prose only at 60px with wide leading: the hero proves it

reconstruction.layout: 100vh, ~1100px centred; four lines from y≈230; small credit lines at y≈585
reconstruction.typography: 62px Jabin Typeface, thin (wght axis low), leading ~1.4, centred, off-white; credit 14px IBM Plex Sans
reconstruction.content: Designer's first-person note: 'Feel free to use it in personal projects and let me know what you think.'

instances.look: Bottom half of the hero block: a borderless two-row grid of seven pink and mint GIFs of single items (punctuation, dagger, fraction, fi ligature, JT, @, rows of dots)
instances.ux: Each GIF morphs a glyph along the axes in a loop
instances.learn: Pick the most exotic items in the set and let them animate alone on black

reconstruction.layout: 4 columns at ~360px, 2 rows ~300px, centred; GIFs on the page colour so the cards are invisible
reconstruction.behaviour: Looping animated GIFs; the file names (punctuation, dagger, fraction, ligature, JT, at, period) identify the subjects
reconstruction.content: Punctuation, dagger, 3/4 fraction, fi, JT, @, a dot pattern

instances.look: Two panels: pink with huge 'Aa' on metric lines and numeric readouts along the bottom; black with symbols on the same frame (captured nearly empty mid-loop)
instances.feel: A type editor's window as art
instances.ux: GIFs loop: letters sweep the axes while the metric lines and values update
instances.learn: Keep the font editor's metric lines and numbers in the GIF: they turn a morph into an explanation

reconstruction.layout: 1240px row of two tiles ~620×421, no gap, centred, ~110px side margin
reconstruction.behaviour: Looping GIF exported from the type editor; lines stay, the outline changes

instances.look: A dim photo of a parchment sheet with wax seal, printed 'Inspired by George Shelley' in the typeface, in a three-slide carousel on near-black, with arrows and dots
instances.feel: Old document in a dark archive
instances.ux: Manual slider (no autoplay), side arrows and three dots
instances.learn: Render the specimen as a physical old sheet to pay respect to the genre

reconstruction.layout: 1000px tall full-width slider, sheet ~920×580 centred; arrows at x≈30/1405, dots centred below
reconstruction.behaviour: Webflow slider: animation slide, 500ms, autoplay false
reconstruction.content: Text about Shelley and the Gutenberg Bible

instances.look: Seven centred lines of blackletter on oxblood explaining the sources
instances.learn: Set the origin note in the font itself, even at the edge of readability, when the font's point is ornament

reconstruction.content: 'Jabin was inspired by George Shelley's work on the cover "The Second Part of Natural Scripture" and in the Gutenberg Bible…'

instances.look: The word 'Fraktur' huge in pink on dark teal, with concentric ornaments and small sidebearing numbers along the baseline
instances.ux: GIF loops the word along the XXXX and wght axes
instances.learn: Choose one word from the genre as the test string, and show its live values on the baseline

reconstruction.layout: Tile 1240×655 centred; word ~1130px wide; number row at bottom

instances.look: Three animated specimen sheets: a teal certificate-like 'Jabin Typeface' document, a tall pink page with big ligature, a tall black page with a 'Time' word and clock hand
instances.learn: A certificate layout is a natural form for blackletter; the axis morph brings it to life

reconstruction.layout: Row 1240px: wide 690×513, two narrow 215×513, small gaps, centred

instances.look: 'License Agreement' title, a chatty note in serif, then three dark-teal cards: Variable font with two axis (personal), Font family: 12 styles (personal), Desktop and variable font (commercial, 20 dlls), each with Download and Contribute buttons
instances.feel: A friend sharing files, with clear rules
instances.ux: Download gets the zip; Contribute goes to PayPal ($10 suggested); licence links open agreement pages
instances.learn: Pair each download with a small voluntary 'Contribute' button: the pay-what-you-want ask stays at each moment of choice

reconstruction.layout: Title centred ~62px; note ~24px; three cards 390×495, 8px gap in a 1200px row; darker button footer strip per card
reconstruction.typography: Title Jabin Bold 62px; note Spectral 24px; card label 12px; card title ~34px Jabin; body 18px Ppmori or IBM Plex Sans; buttons 11px bold
reconstruction.content: 'Update: I updated this version with new things I learned of variable fonts…'; 'Buy for 20 dlls the commercial version'

instances.look: 'Explore additional projects.' at 78px in grey sans, then two big rounded cards with short captions: Kalnia Typeface, A Million Miles Away
instances.ux: Card click goes to the case study
instances.learn: Hard cut to a neutral portfolio section ends a themed page clearly

reconstruction.layout: 1257px section on #101010, 2 columns of ~615×750 rounded cards
reconstruction.typography: 78px Ppmori, half white half grey; captions 30px

instances.look: Mint bar with two centred 14px lines: licence links, email, Glyphs.app reference, and social links
instances.learn: State the tools used in one line; other designers find it useful

reconstruction.content: 'All info in Personal License Agreement and the Commercial License Agreement…'
